source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A folder custom color sets --icon-color inline. The busy and error selectors must override that value so the clock and warning icon keep their state colors; the error rule uses --icon-color rather than fill. D209494 checked the relation with the existing fill rule and noted that the loading icon uses its stroke. Check custom-color folders in both states when editing these selectors.
title: Give busy and error folder icons their state colors over custom colors
